summary: Coincheck Group N.V. furnished a Form 6-K reporting the outcome of its September 25, 2026 annual general meeting. Shareholders voted on 168,388,072 shares, approving the FY2026 remuneration report and annual accounts, discharge of directors, reappointment of KPMG as auditor, and election of nine directors, including KDDI nominee Shumpei Tatebayashi, expanding the board from nine to ten. Other approvals cover an 18-month issuance authorization for up to 63,000,000 shares, exclusion of pre-emptive rights, buyback authority for up to 10% of shares, and share cancellation. This is a routine meeting result, not a special situation.
